scenarios.title: A prevention effect stops the damage events it matches and no others

setup.notes: No creature is summoning sick. Both libraries are non-empty.

decisions: A casts Fog, tapping Forest.
Both players pass; Fog resolves.
A moves to combat and declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass through the combat damage step.

variants.label: combat-damage
variants.expected: Fog resolved. Grizzly Bears's 2 combat damage to B is prevented; B stays at 20 life.

variants.label: noncombat-damage
variants.delta: Instead of attacking, A casts Shock targeting B, tapping Mountain, after Fog resolves.
variants.expected: Fog resolved. Shock's 2 damage to B is not combat damage and is not prevented; B is at 18 life.

scenarios.title: A prevention effect lasts until its duration ends and does not carry into the next turn

setup.notes: No creature is summoning sick. Both libraries are non-empty. Grizzly Bears has been under B's control since before this turn.

decisions: A passes priority in its own end step without casting anything.
The turn passes to B. B untaps and draws.
B moves to combat and declares Grizzly Bears as an attacker, attacking A.
In the declare attackers step A casts Fog, tapping Forest; both players pass and Fog resolves.
A declares no blockers (A has no creatures). Both players pass through the combat damage step.

variants.label: same-turn
variants.expected: Fog resolves during B's turn. Grizzly Bears's 2 combat damage to A is prevented; A stays at 20 life.

variants.label: earlier-turn
variants.delta: A casts Fog in its own end step (it resolves there) instead of during B's combat.
variants.expected: Fog resolves in A's end step and its 'this turn' duration ends with that turn. On B's turn Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to A; A is at 18 life.

scenarios.forge_notes: The scenario spans two turns; the step name only gives the starting point.

scenarios.title: A prevention effect must exist before the damage event it would modify
decisions: B casts Shock targeting A, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; A casts Mending Hands targeting A, tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Mending Hands resolves.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: in-response
variants.expected: Mending Hands resolves first and creates a shield of 4 on A. Shock's 2 damage is prevented; A stays at 20 life.

variants.label: too-late
variants.delta: A does not respond. Shock resolves, and only afterwards A casts Mending Hands targeting A.
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to A before the shield exists; A is at 18 life. Mending Hands then resolves and the damage already dealt is not undone; A stays at 18.

scenarios.title: The additional effect of a prevention effect uses the amount prevented and happens right after the prevention
decisions: B casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: another-creature
variants.expected: Vigor prevents the 2 damage to Grizzly Bears, then Grizzly Bears gets 2 +1/+1 counters (4/4). No damage is marked on it.

variants.label: vigor-itself
variants.delta: Shock targets Vigor instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Vigor only applies to another creature, so Vigor has 2 damage marked, no counters, and stays on the battlefield (6/6). Grizzly Bears is unchanged.

scenarios.forge_notes: Vigor's script is a DamageDone replacement with PreventionEffect and ExecuteMode$ PerTarget that puts counters equal to the damage.

scenarios.title: Prevented damage never happens, so effects that need the damage to be dealt do not happen either

setup.notes: No creature is summoning sick. Both libraries are non-empty.

decisions: A moves to combat and declares Typhoid Rats as an attacker, attacking B.
B declares Grizzly Bears as a blocker of Typhoid Rats.
B casts Mending Hands targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Plains; both players pass and Mending Hands resolves.
Both players pass through the combat damage step.

variants.label: shield-on-victim
variants.expected: Typhoid Rats's 1 damage to Grizzly Bears is prevented, so deathtouch has no damage to act on and Grizzly Bears survives with no damage. Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Typhoid Rats, which dies.

variants.label: shield-on-rats
variants.delta: Mending Hands targets Typhoid Rats instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears's 2 damage to Typhoid Rats is prevented and Typhoid Rats survives. Typhoid Rats deals 1 deathtouch damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies.

variants.label: no-shield
variants.delta: B does not cast Mending Hands.
variants.expected: Typhoid Rats deals 1 deathtouch damage to Grizzly Bears and Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Typhoid Rats; both die.

scenarios.title: A damage-amount shield prevents damage one point at a time and is used up at zero
decisions: B casts Lightning Bolt targeting A, tapping one Mountain.
B passes priority; A casts Mending Hands targeting A, tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Mending Hands resolves.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: bolt-within-shield
variants.expected: Mending Hands creates a shield of 4 on A. Lightning Bolt's 3 damage is entirely prevented; A stays at 20 life with 1 point of shield left.

variants.label: axe-exceeds-shield
variants.delta: B casts Lava Axe (tapping all five Mountains) targeting A instead of Lightning Bolt; A responds with Mending Hands as before.
variants.expected: Mending Hands prevents 4 of Lava Axe's 5 damage; the shield is then at 0 and the remaining 1 damage is dealt. A is at 19 life.

variants.label: two-events
variants.delta: B casts Shock targeting A instead of Lightning Bolt, and after it resolves casts a second Shock targeting A (tapping a second Mountain).
variants.expected: The shield prevents the first Shock's 2 damage (2 left) and the second Shock's 2 damage (0 left); the number of events does not matter. A stays at 20 life.

scenarios.title: A next-time prevention effect prevents one whole instance of damage from the chosen source

setup.notes: No creature is summoning sick. Both libraries are non-empty.

decisions: A moves to combat and declares Raging Redcap and Hill Giant as attackers, attacking B.
B activates Circle of Protection: Red, paying {1} with a Plains, and chooses Raging Redcap as the source; both players pass and the ability resolves.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass through the first-strike damage step and then the regular combat damage step.

variants.label: second-instance
variants.expected: Raging Redcap's 1 first-strike damage to B is prevented. Its 1 regular combat damage and Hill Giant's 3 combat damage are dealt. B is at 16 life.

variants.label: big-single-hit
variants.delta: B chooses Hill Giant as the source instead of Raging Redcap.
variants.expected: Hill Giant's 3 combat damage to B is prevented. Raging Redcap's 1 first-strike and 1 regular combat damage are dealt. B is at 18 life.

variants.label: no-shield
variants.delta: B does not activate Circle of Protection: Red.
variants.expected: Raging Redcap deals 1 first-strike and 1 regular combat damage and Hill Giant deals 3 combat damage to B. B is at 15 life.

scenarios.forge_notes: Circle of Protection: Red is implemented as an Effect with a replacement that exiles itself after one use.

scenarios.title: A shield for a source with certain properties rechecks the source when it would deal damage

setup.notes: No creature is summoning sick. Both libraries are non-empty.

decisions: A moves to combat and declares Wild Mongrel as an attacker, attacking B.
B activates Circle of Protection: Green, paying {1} with a Plains, and chooses Wild Mongrel as the source; both players pass and the ability resolves.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass through the combat damage step.

variants.label: still-green
variants.expected: Wild Mongrel is still a green source when it deals its 2 combat damage; the damage is prevented and B stays at 20 life.

variants.label: recolored
variants.delta: After the ability resolves, A activates Wild Mongrel discarding the Mountain from hand, choosing red; the ability resolves.
variants.expected: Wild Mongrel is a 3/3 red creature when damage is dealt, no longer matching the shield. Its 3 damage is dealt to B (17 life) and the shield is not used up.

scenarios.forge_notes: The ChooseSource choice is made on resolution, so the recoloring response must come after the ability resolves. Forge rechecks the colour through ValidSource Card.ChosenCardStrict+GreenSource.

scenarios.title: A static prevention effect of a fixed amount applies separately to each damage event
decisions: B casts Shock targeting Daunting Defender, tapping a Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: cleric
variants.expected: Daunting Defender (a 3/3 Cleric) takes 2 damage minus 1 prevented: 1 damage is marked. It stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: non-cleric
variants.delta: Shock targets Grizzly Bears instead of Daunting Defender.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is not a Cleric, so nothing is prevented; it takes 2 damage and dies.

variants.label: second-event
variants.delta: B casts a second Shock targeting Daunting Defender, tapping the other Mountain, after the first resolves.
variants.expected: Each Shock has 1 of its 2 damage prevented separately. Daunting Defender has 2 damage marked in total (3/3) and survives.

scenarios.title: A radiance prevention effect creates a shield for each applicable creature when it resolves
decisions: A activates Wojek Apothecary (tapping it) targeting Grizzly Bears; both players pass and the ability resolves.
A casts Pyroclasm, tapping both Mountains; both players pass and Pyroclasm resolves.

variants.label: green-shield
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears and the other green creature Runeclaw Bear each get a shield of 1, so each takes 1 of Pyroclasm's 2 damage and survives. Walking Corpse (black) and Wojek Apothecary (white) have no shield and die.

variants.label: black-shield
variants.delta: The Apothecary's ability targets Walking Corpse instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Only Walking Corpse gets a shield: it takes 1 damage and survives. Grizzly Bears and Runeclaw Bear die, and so does Wojek Apothecary.

variants.label: enters-later
variants.delta: After the ability resolves and before Pyroclasm, A casts the Runeclaw Bear from hand, tapping both Forests.
variants.expected: The Runeclaw Bear that entered later has no shield and dies to Pyroclasm. Grizzly Bears and the Runeclaw Bear already on the battlefield survive with 1 damage; Walking Corpse and Wojek Apothecary die.

scenarios.title: Damage that can't be prevented ignores a shield and does not reduce it
decisions: B casts Flames of the Blood Hand targeting A, tapping three Mountains.
B passes priority; A casts Mending Hands targeting A, tapping Plains.
Both players pass; Mending Hands resolves.
Both players pass; Flames of the Blood Hand resolves.
B casts Lightning Bolt targeting A, tapping the fourth Mountain; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: unpreventable-first
variants.expected: Flames of the Blood Hand's 4 damage is dealt in full (A at 16) and the shield of 4 is not reduced. The Lightning Bolt's 3 damage is then entirely prevented by the intact shield; A stays at 16 life.

variants.label: preventable-first
variants.delta: B casts Lightning Bolt first (tapping one Mountain) instead of Flames of the Blood Hand, and then the second Lightning Bolt (tapping another Mountain).
variants.expected: The first Lightning Bolt's 3 damage is prevented and reduces the shield to 1. The second Lightning Bolt has 1 damage prevented and 2 dealt; A is at 18 life.

scenarios.title: A trigger on damage being prevented fires when a prevention effect prevents damage
decisions: B casts Lightning Bolt targeting A, tapping Mountain.
B passes priority; A casts Selfless Squire (flash), tapping four Plains; both players pass and Selfless Squire resolves.
Selfless Squire's enters trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves, preventing all damage to A this turn.
Both players pass; Lightning Bolt resolves.

variants.label: damage-to-player
variants.expected: Lightning Bolt's 3 damage to A is prevented; A stays at 20 life. Selfless Squire's prevented-damage trigger fires and Selfless Squire gets 3 +1/+1 counters (4/4).

variants.label: damage-to-creature
variants.delta: Lightning Bolt targets Grizzly Bears instead of A.
variants.expected: The prevention covers only damage to A, so Grizzly Bears takes 3 damage and dies. No damage is prevented, the trigger does not fire, and Selfless Squire stays 1/1.
